title: DarkMusic 1.5.25 Release
changelog:
• Consistent Lyrics Shape & Length: Active and inactive lyrics now share identical word-wrapped layout to eliminate popping, jumping, and line re-wrapping.
• Randomized Top 30 Most Played: Home screen Most Played now presents your top 30 favorite tracks in a fresh randomized order without rank badges.
• Home Layout Refinement: Downloaded Songs section is now positioned directly beneath the Artists section.
• Search Bar Stability: Fixed input dropping and cursor position jumping when searching in the track library.
releaseNotes: v1.5.25: Consistent lyrics shape and wrapping, randomized top 30 most played, downloaded songs reordering, and search input stability.
